findings.issue: Starting with the subject ('Una solicitud de red falló durante la actualización.') is grammatical, but it reads like a word-for-word copy of the English. The usual Spanish order puts the verb first: 'Falló una solicitud de red durante la actualización.' The meaning does not change.
'Paso de cambio de versión' describes a switch-over well enough, but it is wordier than the other step labels. 'Paso de transición' would be shorter. It fits at 320px either way.

The existing sibling strings say 'Esta app inició ese servidor'. This one says 'La app inició este servidor'. Both are correct and the English sources differ in the same way, so this is recorded only as a consistency note.
